# gcore_cloud_registries (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_cloud_registries" "example_cloud_registries" {
  project_id = 1
  region_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `project_id` (Number) Project ID
- `region_id` (Number) Region ID

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Registry creation date-time
- `id` (Number) Registry ID
- `name` (String) Registry name
- `repo_count` (Number) Number of repositories in the registry
- `storage_limit` (Number) Registry storage limit, GiB
- `storage_used` (Number) Registry storage used, bytes
- `updated_at` (String) Registry modification date-time
- `url` (String) Registry url
